translation.description: English translation of the 341-style code-animation prompt pack, from the Chinese upstream (XiaoyeCodes/code-animation-prompts) into this fork (GiorMalik/Animations-Prompt).
translation.scope: All 341 style prompts, the core docs (README, SKILL.md, INSTALL.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, LICENSE.md), the library notes (about.md, license-and-sources.md, attribution.md), the picker (style-picker.html) and its embedded data, the catalog (references/catalog.json), the style index (docs/STYLES.md), the install/validation/build scripts, and the file and folder names under assets/library (style prompts, examples, screenshots). Prompts were translated from Chinese; example on-screen text is now English. The two B6 example HTML files keep their original code and behaviour; only their on-screen strings and code comments were translated (work title, subtitle line, and the curator credit, romanised as Fuyang Guanzhao).
exceptions: The 家 glyph in B3's {{default: 家}} placeholder is kept on purpose: it is the character drawn in the artwork itself.
The 囍 glyph in Z5_Paper_Cutting.md is kept on purpose: it is the character to be cut out of the paper.
The Bilibili curator's proper name 俯仰观照 is kept in LICENSE.md and attribution.md.
translation.baseline: docs/source-manifest.json now records the SHA-256 hashes of the translated file set (558 files under skills/code-animation-prompts/assets/library/), replacing the upstream Chinese baseline. There are no further modifications relative to this translated baseline, so "modified" and "added" below are empty.
